curriculum.name: move_visit_and_parent
curriculum.goal: Given a place, move the most recent visit and also the event it belongs to (its parent) to that place, and return the visit.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE move_visit_and_parent(place:PLACE)
$v0 = FIND_LAST VISIT
UPDATE $v0 WHERE={place}
$v1 = PARENT $v0
UPDATE $v1 WHERE={place}
RETURN $v0
END

post_turns.text: REQUEST both the visit and its parent go to Rome
